name: offer-master
description: Offer Master: end-to-end framework to diagnose buyer drop-offs, score 4 value levers, rebuild packaging on real proof, cost capped guarantees, and audit honesty into paste-ready offer cards.

interface.shortDescription: Diagnose, rebuild, price, and guarantee honest high-converting offers
interface.longDescription: Offer Master fixes offers that aren't selling without hype: finds funnel drop-offs, decodes buyer objections, scores 4 value levers (Result, Belief, Speed, Ease), packages the core promise, costs capped guarantees, calculates real pricing, and audits honesty.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose why my offer isn't selling and decode the objections.
Score my offer across the four value levers (Result, Belief, Speed, Ease).
Design a fair, capped guarantee and calculate its cost per sale.
Audit my sales page copy for honesty, fake urgency, and unbacked claims.
Rebuild my entire offer into a paste-ready offer card.
